purpose: Preview-only art-direction sheet, not production sprites

steps.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE art-direction comparison sheet for Gym-Beam workout app, not final individual production sprites. Create a landscape 3 by 2 contact sheet of SIX humorous full-body gym characters, all unmistakably drawn by the SAME pixel artist, with the game-character readability and affectionate 1980s/1990s movie-reference humor associated with Punch Club. Make original reinterpretations, not copied game assets. Reference image 1 is the existing Levsha character: use only the idea of a clever craftsman with magnifier. Reference image 2 is Atlas: use only the recognizable overhead globe silhouette. Reference image 3 is the current beginner: use only general pixel-character readability, NOT the miserable expression or skeletal proportions. Unify them into one fresh visual system. Each sprite should look designed on a coarse approximately 96x128 logical pixel grid and enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbor pixel edges; restrained one/two-pixel dark outlines, three simple shade steps, consistent upper-left lighting, same 3/4 camera, same foot baseline within each row, same head-to-body proportions, similar actual body height, and enough space above Atlas for his carried object. Not high-resolution paintings disguised by a pixel filter, no noisy dithering or blurry airbrush. Flat deep neutral graphite #101214 background across the whole board, unframed cells, generous spacing, thin neutral separators if needed, no cards or decorative scenery. Colors vary coherently: ice blue, orange accent, red boxing details, yellow martial-arts tracksuit, cool steel, natural skin tones. Each character gets ONE readable gym-related visual gag, with no weapons. Left to right top row: 1. 'НОВИЧОК': ordinary approachable adult with a turquoise gym bag, looking determinedly at an oversized gym entry key tag, not weak or emaciated. 2. 'ЛЕВША': wiry inventive craftsman in a short gym apron, using a magnifier to inspect a barbell spring collar, witty confident face. 3. 'РОККИ НА РАЙОНЕ': recognizable affectionate Rocky-style curly dark-haired underdog in grey training sweats and red boxing gloves, a gym towel over one shoulder, cheeky ready stance. Left to right bottom row: 4. 'БРЮС ЖИМ': recognizable Bruce Lee-inspired lean athletic martial artist in yellow tracksuit with black stripe, holding two small weight plates with disciplined balance and a raised eyebrow. 5. 'ТЕРМИНАТОР ПОДХОДОВ': recognizable gym parody of the Terminator, black sleeveless workout clothes, compact cool-steel cyborg arm and single small red eye, lifting one end of a barbell while studying a tiny rest stopwatch in his other hand, no gun, not a frightening scene. 6. 'АТЛАС': powerful classic bearded Atlas in dark athletic shorts with a simple Greek belt, carrying a recognizable blue globe overhead with a gym lifting belt around the globe as the joke; no magic aura, glow, particles or background spheres. Add a compact title at top exactly 'GYM-BEAM / УРОВНИ'. Put each exact quoted Russian character name UNDER its sprite, in clean readable light lettering, two lines when needed. These labels are for the concept sheet only, not part of the sprite drawing. No captions, no extra characters, no watermarks. Keep ALL six figures fully in frame and clearly legible even when viewed as small icons. The mood is smart, warm gym satire, never humiliation for body size or pain.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this Gym-Beam six-character concept sheet. Make ONE targeted change ONLY to the top-right character labelled 'РОККИ НА РАЙОНЕ': remove the red headband entirely and make him clearly an affectionate Rocky Balboa-inspired 1980s training underdog, with short naturally curly dark hair, no martial-arts bandana, a grey hooded sweatshirt with the hood resting on his back, grey sweatpants, red boxing gloves, and the same towel on his shoulder. His pose should be a simple natural boxer guard, without the exaggerated eyebrows associated with Street Fighter. Keep his face playful and determined. Match the existing pixel-art style, pixel density, shading and height. Preserve the other FIVE characters, their props, their poses, the exact labels, the sheet title, cell placement, horizontal dividers, graphite background and overall composition unchanged. No new text, no watermark, no additional objects. This remains a concept sheet, not production sprites.
